title: Underlying sheaf maps are determined by nested completed scalar tensor sections
statement: For a nested completed scalar extension, equality of the underlying sheaf morphism components on every nested completed scalar tensor section implies equality of the underlying presheaf morphisms.

proof.text: Specialize sheafRingCoefficientOrdinaryAdjunction to each completed coefficient map. The completedOrdinaryScalarExtension object and map equations identify the recorded functor with sheafified tensor extension. Evaluate the adjunction Hom formula on the inverse equality transport to prove that its unit sends x to completedScalarTensorSection with coefficient 1. This is a private proved specialization, with the existing pro-etale abelian sheafification instances.

Apply injectivity of the outer extension/restriction Hom equivalence, then injectivity of the inner Hom equivalence. Extensionality on the remaining module-sheaf morphisms reduces to equality on each section x. Adjunction.homEquiv_unit expresses the two double adjuncts as f and g evaluated on the successive units. Replace both units by their pure tensor formulas and apply the given hypothesis with both scalar coefficients equal to 1. Apply congrArg to the underlying presheaf morphism projection.
